_doc: Guided tour for The Stone Angel. Times t are TOUR seconds; narration starts at narrationAt (so narration time n = t - narrationAt). Keyframes: lon/lat/fov (vertical fov, WebGL convention; the camera adapter maps it onto Viewer2D zoom). stop:true = camera comes to rest on that keyframe (zero velocity); otherwise motion flows through it (Catmull-Rom). The first keyframe (t=0) is replaced at runtime by wherever the user is looking. Scene anchors measured on panos/grav_angel_statue.jpg (2048x1024): angel head lon -2.5 lat 38, wings lon -40..42 lat 20..43, candle rows lon -14..22 lat -50..-59, left great tree trunk lon -117, left fog bank lon -180..-115. Narration word times from forced alignment (vosk) of narration.mp3.

captions.text: You've found it. The old churchyard… where the fog keeps its promises.
Stay a while. The dead don't mind visitors — they get so few.
There she is. The Stone Angel.
Two hundred years of rain and frost have worn her face smooth, but she still watches.
Count the votive candles at her feet… if you can.
The number changes. It always changes.
Listen. The wind through the yew trees carries names. Old ones.
Whisper one back, and the fog will part just enough to let you pass.
But mind the hour. When the bell tolls,
the angel turns her head — only a little, only once.
And if you ever hear her wings unfold…
She is only deciding whether you are the mourner… or the mourned.
The candles know you're here now.
